steps.name: Pass 1 / level 1
steps.confirm_message: Collection 1, units {units} (001 L, 010 M1, 100 M2): weigh one empty vessel per running unit and enter the masses. Position them before confirming. Collect each entire dispense, then weigh and enter the final masses before the next collection. Keep the filled bypass paths unchanged. This is before/after weighing; no time-series balance logging is required.
